failure_summary.description: Included descriptive provider text in the tool identifier instead of using the canonical provider name and endpoint label; calls also did not follow the required tool-name order.

patch.reasoning: The response format requires canonical tool identifiers, but the tool listing appended a description to the provider name and the agent copied that text into the identifier. Clarify how to form identifiers from structured Provider/API listings. Call ordering is already covered by the skill, so no duplicate edit is needed.

edits.target: - If the active answer format specifies an order for calls (for example, sorting by tool name), reorder the completed call objects to match it before responding; do not retain narrative task order.
edits.content: - When a tool listing separates `Provider`, `API`, and `Description`, and the required identifier format is `Provider: endpoint`, use the canonical provider name and API endpoint label. Do not include descriptive text appended to the provider name or copy the API description into the identifier; follow the active format's example for punctuation.
